entries.desc: A PLAN-phase story has passing verificationEvidence refs such as CHK-001:happy:0 but no stored verificationIntent -> lattice verification_intent_repair with mode=fromEvidence dryRun prints reconstructed intent, and the non-dry run writes only the missing lane/index entries plus an audit event; WHY: proves the mid-flight legacy repair path exists without hand-editing story metadata.

evidence.note: reconstruct: missing intent filled from passing evidence (priority=should, kind→type mapped)

entries.desc: A checklist item already has authored verificationIntent on one lane while other evidenced lanes are missing -> repair preserves the authored text and fills only missing entries unless replaceExisting is explicitly requested with a strong reason; WHY: protects the acceptance contract from accidental overwrite.

evidence.note: reconstruct: NEVER overwrites authored intent on a lane that already has one

entries.desc: A DEV/REVIEW/TEST story needs legacy repair -> command rejects missing legacyRepair or a short/empty reason, then succeeds with legacyRepair=true and a substantial reason while recording phase/reason/head/material audit data; WHY: verifies protected-phase mutation stays explicit and auditable.

evidence.note: CLI flag-form run proves DEV repair works; preflight rejects missing legacyRepair / short reason; INIT/INIT_CHECK/terminal refused

entries.desc: Evidence refs are malformed, point at unknown checklist items or lanes, or represent failing evidence -> repair reports the problematic refs, does not guess generated intent, and leaves checklist intent unchanged; WHY: prevents evidence from becoming a silent or lossy substitute for authored intent.

evidence.note: reconstruct: malformed item-scoped ref fails closed (throws); failing/waiver evidence never used; foreign ref skipped

entries.desc: story_review sees missing verificationIntent for a lane that already has matching evidence refs -> it still blocks with type=missing_verification_intent and evidenceAware=true details including itemId, lane, evidenceRefs, repairHint, and a suggested lattice verification_intent_repair command; WHY: gives the reviewer the precise legacy repair path instead of a generic blocker while preserving existing issue-type compatibility.

evidence.note: Integration: legacy-evidence-no-intent asserts story_review emits a missing_verification_intent blocker with legacyEvidenceWithoutIntent=true and repairCommand=verification_intent_repair

entries.desc: lattice validate runs on a story with evidence refs but no stored intent -> validation remains failing/missing coverage but prints the same repair hint instead of implying evidence can pass by itself; WHY: keeps validation aligned with review while preserving intent as the gate contract.

evidence.note: Integration: legacy-evidence-no-intent calls validate --json and asserts response.legacyEvidenceWithoutIntent names CHK-001 happy (the decorateStoryVerification hint path)

entries.desc: A story lacks verificationIntent and has no matching evidence refs -> diagnostics keep the normal missing_verification_intent behavior without a legacy repair-specific claim; WHY: avoids misleading operators when there is no deterministic reconstruction source.

evidence.note: verify-story-review-structured-output ok missing-intent: no-evidence missing intent keeps the generic blocker behavior

entries.desc: Existing callers or smoke tests still expect the legacy issue type -> structured output preserves compatibility by retaining type=missing_verification_intent and adding evidenceAware, evidenceRefs, repairHint, and suggestedCommand fields for the richer case; WHY: prevents diagnostics improvement from breaking current review tooling.

evidence.note: existing missing_verification_intent type/blockerCount contract preserved (verify-story-review-structured-output passes)

entries.desc: Evidence-aware diagnostics are emitted during review or validation -> blocker severity is not downgraded and story_review/validate cannot pass until verificationIntent is actually repaired or authored; WHY: prevents the hint from weakening lifecycle gates for normal stories.

evidence.note: Integration: legacy-evidence-no-intent asserts the legacy issue stays severity=blocker and a no-evidence lane keeps the generic blocker (gate not weakened)

entries.desc: A wrapper metadata root is not a git repository but lattice.config.json has a valid nested gitRoot -> session_brief resolves the signed workspace and story_advance INIT_CHECK creates the story branch and worktree by running git operations from the material git root; WHY: proves valid wrapper-root projects can bootstrap without manual worktree creation.

evidence.note: nested-gitroot: wrapper metadata root is not git, configured gitRoot subdir hosts worktree+branch; INIT_CHECK succeeds

entries.desc: worktreeDir is configured under the wrapper metadata root while git operations run from the nested material repo -> bootstrap preserves story metadata in the configured store and records story.worktree.path in the existing downstream-compatible format; WHY: verifies metadata root and git material root stay separate without breaking later commands.

evidence.note: nested-gitroot asserts worktree under <gitRoot>/.worktrees and metadata under configured storyDir inside gitRoot

entries.desc: Existing non-wrapper projects use the repository root as both metadata and material root -> INIT_CHECK behavior and worktree paths remain compatible with the current single-root flow; WHY: guards against regressions in the common layout while adding gitRoot support.

evidence.note: plain-repo scenarios (branch-isolation/scoped-stage/dry-run/bad-branch) stay green: getRepoRoot fallback byte-for-byte unchanged

entries.desc: gitRoot is missing, non-git, or disallowed by signed workspace policy -> INIT_CHECK fails with the same signed-workspace reason vocabulary as session_brief and does not leave a partial branch/worktree mutation; WHY: keeps bootstrap failures actionable and avoids split-brain workspace state.

evidence.note: invalid-gitroot: configured gitRoot that is not a git repo fails closed with signed-workspace reason, no worktree created

entries.desc: The smoke suite creates a legacy story with passing evidence refs and no intent -> it proves story_review blocks with a repair hint, verification_intent_repair dryRun shows generated intent, repair writes missing intent, and story_review no longer reports missing intent for repaired lanes; WHY: covers the core incident path end to end.

evidence.note: smoke creates legacy items with passing evidence refs and asserts reconstruction
